name: Resume optimizer
acceptanceCriteria: /resumes page shows a drag-drop upload zone with icon and instructions
Upload zone explicitly says PDF, DOCX, or TXT is accepted and mentions a size cap (4MB)
Below the upload zone, the user sees either an empty-state message or a list of their resumes
Each resume row shows filename, file type badge, and an 'updated' date
Each resume row has a trash/delete icon button
Clicking a resume (or navigating to /resumes/[id]) opens the detail page
Detail page has a 'Target role' input field
Detail page has a togglable 'Paste job description' optional area
Detail page has a 'Rewrite for this role' primary button
Detail page renders parsed sections as collapsible blocks when available
Rewrite output appears in a streaming violet panel with a sparkle icon
antiPatterns: Upload zone accepts unsupported file types silently
Target role input is disabled by default
Detail page shows raw HTML or broken markdown

screenshots.expect: The /resumes page with upload dropzone and (empty or populated) list
Navigation to /resumes shows the page; if no resume exists, the list is empty — this screenshot verifies the empty-state text
